verdict_text:
YES

The script drops exactly the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` buffers (fullmatch on the buffer pattern), casts exactly the 48 projection matrices with `tensor.to(torch.bfloat16)` (round-to-nearest-even), leaves every other tensor float32 with unchanged values, preserves names, and asserts all four required checks (48 bf16, `h.0.attn.c_attn.weight` bf16, `wte.weight` fp32, 148 tensors) before writing. One caveat on verifiability: the sharding and index-file requirements (clause 5) are delegated to `_ckpt.save_sharded_safetensors`, which is not part of the artifact shown, so the 64 MiB shard limit, the lone-shard placement of `wte.weight`, and the `model.safetensors.index.json` `weight_map` are correct only if that helper is.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
